svg.aria-label: Index card. RescueLens: identifies cars at crash sites. Names a car’s make, model and year from one photo and shows rescuers where its high voltage runs. Says so when it isn’t sure. Key result: 94.55% top-1, 196 classes. CV Hackathon 2026. PyTorch, YOLO11, ONNX.
